Parents who choose Zaffar usually hope their child will grow to embody gold, success and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is a precious metal that is highly valued and sought after. The name Zaffar represents these qualities and is often given to a child as a blessing for success and prosperity in life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Zaffar can be seen as a reminder of the value of inner wealth. It encourages us to strive for success and victory not just in external pursuits, but also in our inner selves. The name can inspire us to seek spiritual gold, which is the ultimate goal of life according to Hindu philosophy. data.spiritual_symbolism: Zaffar in Hinduism symbolizes courage, victory, and divine protection. The name is derived from the Persian word 'Zafar' which means 'victorious' or 'conqueror'. For Hindus, Zaffar embodies the spirit of overcoming challenges and achieving success through the grace and guidance of the divine.

historical_references.reference: Zaffar Khan was a celebrated Mughal general and a close confidant of Emperor Jahangir. He was given the title 'Asaf Khan' in 1605, and later the title 'Zaffar Khan' in 1611.

Another Zaffar Khan, a Hindu Rajput, is mentioned in the chronicles of the Rajput king, Raja Jai Singh of Amer. He is said to have served under Shah Jahan in the late 17th century and later rebelled against him.

Acuna's 'Occupied America: A History of Chicanos' as a notable figure in the Mexican Revolution. Lastly, in graphic design art, it is a popular name for calligraphy and typography designs, one of which is the 'Zaffar Script' created by a popular design studio.
